title: DeLonge's meetings at the Pentagon and NASA

tellings.quote: A bunch of meetings start. So he's flown out to the Pentagon where he meets with someone and they say, "Okay, now you're going to NASA." Where he meets with some people. I think arguably you could say maybe Pete Worden who's a one-star NASA general may have been there.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that around 2015 and 2016 the musician Tom DeLonge began a run of meetings with officials. According to Simosa, DeLonge was flown to the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US Defense Department, where he met someone who then sent him on to NASA, the US space agency, and Simosa thinks a man he calls a one-star NASA general, Pete Worden, may have been there. If true, it would mean people inside government were quietly guiding DeLonge's UFO work.
